coverage: Worldwide config/global_bounds.json (lon -180..180, lat -90..90, 3600x1800) + NA nest. No shoreline cut. Gaps transparent.
display_units: dBZ-equivalent qualitative intensity (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) + compatible ECCC intensity (outside MRMS)
eccc_units: rain mm/h, snow cm/h (precipitation RATE, not dBZ — not numerically interchangeable with MRMS)
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB + ECCC NA radar, 2-6 min mosaic)

iem_effective_domain.note: Effective CONUS WSR-88D network coverage inside the advertised bbox (lon -171..170, lat 5..70). Footprint of the CONUS radar source (MRMS SeamlessHSR, same WSR-88D network as the old IEM N0Q mosaic); also gates GFS model fill.

mrms_product: MRMS_SeamlessHSR_00.00 (NOAA/NSSL hybrid-scan reflectivity composite, dBZ; -999 missing, -99 no-echo; 2-min cadence) — CONUS and regional Alaska / Hawaii / Caribbean domains
precedence: ECCC rain (rates -> dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4 onto the original N0Q key) wins everywhere its RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV dynamic coverage is valid, including most of CONUS; ECCC snow echoes render on the same N0Q key (no separate snow scale); NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB: measured dBZ onto the original N0Q key bins) fills ECCC gaps; OPERA EU DBZH fills remaining non-NA radar gaps on the N0Q key (undifferentiated); JMA nowcast intensity (mm/h classes) fills Japan gaps via Z-R equivalents (undifferentiated); GFS model estimates (CSNOW/CRAIN, same colors as radar) only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere.
source_name: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
title: LIVE PRECIPITATION
variable: MRMS SeamlessHSR base reflectivity dBZ (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB); ECCC precipitation-rate rain (mm/h)/snow (cm/h) mapped to dBZ through the ECCC 14-color class rates with the NWS Z=300R^1.4 equivalence (equal ECCC colors = equal severity = equal dBZ for rain and snow). One 5-75 dBZ key for all precipitation: rain and snow share it (no snow ramp or snow legend).
visual_note: MRMS reflectivity rendered on the original N0Q key in its domains (measured dBZ -> key bins). ECCC rain and snow mapped to the same 11-step key by class severity. GFS model estimates render in the same colors as radar (disclosed as model output in metadata). There is no separate snow ramp or snow legend. Equal colors across the transition do NOT claim identical measurements.
